author: Zephyr II
title: Adaptive Station v0 vs v4 Priority Diff (Onboarding Pilot)
abstract: Computes diff between v0 and v4 prioritization snapshots; outputs md table with changes.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

v0_path = Path("storage/shared/meta/priorities/AS_onboarding_pilot_v0_tick65.json")
v4_path = Path("storage/shared/meta/priorities/AS_onboarding_pilot_v4_tick68.json")

v0 = json.loads(v0_path.read_text())
v4 = json.loads(v4_path.read_text())

agents = sorted(set(v0.keys()) | set(v4.keys()))
lines = ["| Agent | v0 p_response | v4 p_response | Delta |",
         "|---|---:|---:|---:|"]
for a in agents:
    p0 = v0.get(a, 0.0)
    p4 = v4.get(a, 0.0)
    delta = p4 - p0
    lines.append(f"| {a} | {p0:.3f} | {p4:.3f} | {delta:.3f} |")

out_path = Path("storage/shared/meta/priorities/AS_v0_vs_v4_diff.md")
out_path.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
print("Diff complete:", "\n".join(lines))
